facts.fact: The DGSSI, under the Administration de la Defense nationale, runs a Centre de veille, de detection et de reponse aux attaques informatiques.
The DGSSI said 109 of 879 recorded cyberattacks in 2025 needed direct intervention by its Centre de veille, and it issued 22 security alerts and 511 bulletins.
Minister Delegate Abdellatif Loudiyi gave 879 attacks recorded, 109 direct interventions, 22 alerts and 511 bulletins (248 critical) for 2025.

MAR.note: Mentions only a national legal framework, no law named.
Nothing on who runs government systems.
Technopark Casablanca named only as venue of a master course.
